records.fact: The Schmidts announced a new $1 billion commitment across talent programs and initiatives. The statement describes future support and a mix of charitable and commercial tools; it does not establish one completed $1 billion personal charitable transfer.

The AP/Chronicle report places the approximately $1.1 billion gift of two million Netflix shares to the Hastings Fund at Silicon Valley Community Foundation in January 2024. It does not establish the exact transfer day.

The Genesis Prize Foundation announced ten grant recipients supported by Spielberg’s $1 million 2021 prize and a separate matching contribution. This is a 2021 prize allocation, not a fiscal-year foundation inflow. The announcement does not establish an exact settlement date.

NTI reported fulfillment of conditions attached to the $50 million commitment made in 2006. Buffett’s statement described writing the check as a future action. The 2006 announcement cannot establish a completed transfer in that year.
